newsitem.title: CHINA: China says deeply concerned by Israel settlements.
newsitem.headline: China says deeply concerned by Israel settlements.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it was deeply concerned by what it called Israel's expansion of settlements in the occupied West Bank, urging both Israelis and Palestininians to abide by the terms of their peace agreements.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said he will grant benefits, such as tax breaks, to West Bank settlers -- a move slammed by Palestinian officials as an act of war.
"We are deeply concerned about and disturbed by Israel's expansion of the Jewish settlements in the occupied territories," Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing.

"It is our view that all the agreements that have been reached between the Palestine and Israel should be carried out," he said. "The parties concerned should refrain from taking any action that might further complicate regional tensions."
